name: The Iron Charter
opening: The Iron Charter guild hall smells of polish and old maps. The guildmaster, a broad woman with an eyepatch and a long grey braid, taps a notice on the quest board: DANGEROUS, NO NEWCOMERS. She looks you up and down. 'Unless,' she says, 'you'd like to prove me wrong.'
picture: medium shot, (a broad-shouldered guildmaster with an eyepatch and a grey braid tapping a notice on a crowded quest board, facing the hero:1.25), (stone guild hall with red banners:1.1), torchlight
background: a stone guild hall with bright banners, a quest board covered in notices and torches on the walls
beats: Beat a rival adventuring party to the dangerous quest
Complete the quest no newcomer is allowed to take
secret: The dangerous quest was posted by the guildmaster's missing brother, as a cry for help.

cast.Guildmaster Hilde: a broad-shouldered woman with an eyepatch, a long grey braid and a leather coat
